Synthetic data API¶

Synthetic signal generators for echo/noise-cancellation experiments.

lattice_dsp.synthetic.generate_echo_problem(*, samples=64000, sample_rate=16000, seed=1234, reflection=(0.35, -0.25, 0.15, -0.08), taps=(0.2, -0.1, 0.05, 0.0, 0.75), nonlinear_strength=0.08, nonlinearity='tanh', near_end_power_ratio=0.02, noise_snr_db=30.0, double_talk=True)[source]

Generate a reproducible synthetic nonlinear echo problem.

The linear path is stable because it is parameterized by reflection coefficients. The nonlinear component is intentionally small; the goal is to make the linear lattice/IIR stage useful while leaving a residual that a spectral or downstream residual processor could handle later.

Parameters:

  • samples (int)

  • sample_rate (int)

  • seed (int)

  • reflection (Sequence[float])

  • taps (Sequence[float])

  • nonlinear_strength (float)

  • nonlinearity (Literal['none', 'tanh', 'cubic', 'clipped'])

  • near_end_power_ratio (float)

  • noise_snr_db (float)

  • double_talk (bool)

Return type:

EchoProblem
